desc: Ideate the solution approach (rooting, subtree size modulo K, remainder propagation logic).
Read input $N, K$ and tree edges, build adjacency list.
Implement DFS logic (replaced by iterative BFS/DP in the provided solution).
Collect remainders ($size \% K$) from all children.
If current node's total size % K == 0: All children must have remainder 0.
If current node's total size % K == 1: All children must have remainder 0.
If current node's total size % K == r (where 1 < r < K): Exactly one child must have remainder r-1, all others must be 0.
Return the remainder of the current subtree.
Handle recursion limit for deep trees (handled via iterative approach).
Check root's remainder and validation flags to print "Yes" or "No".
